5359.note: Lorgalis Manuscript comes only from the Pitted Iron Chest 13949 in Blackfathom Deeps, the one container QuestieDB lists. pfQuest also lists the Document Chest 176344 (Barrens/Thousand Needles), a different quest's chest.

16790.note: Damp Note from Blackfathom Tide Priestess requires The Essence of Aku'Mai to be held or completed. The maintainer checked players' recordings: the note appeared in 17 of 29 loot windows with the quest held or done, versus 1 of 24 without; that exception may have completed the quest before recording began. Accepting the quest is enough; it need not be turned in before farming the note.

20519.note: Southsea Pirate Hat (Pirate Hats Ahoy! 8365) drops from six Southsea pirates (7855, 7856, 7857, 7858, 7883, 8203) at 10%, as QuestieDB's Forever store and CMaNGOS classic-db's loot tables have it; neither puts it in the Southsea Kidnapper's (15685) loot. Only pfQuest lists 15685, at 50%, which sent the goal to the Kidnapper alone (issue #327).
